    def __init__(self,meta,config=None):
        super().__init__()
        config={**CONFIG,**(config or {})}
        self.config=config
        self.kind=config['kind']
        self.category=meta['category_field_index'];self.brand=meta['brand_field_index']
        dim=config['embedding_dim']
        self.embeddings=nn.ModuleList([nn.Embedding(size,dim,padding_idx=0) for size in meta['buckets']])

        self.recency=nn.Embedding(33,dim,padding_idx=0)
        self.attention=nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(dim*4,64),nn.PReLU(),nn.Linear(64,1))
        layers=[]
        width=len(meta['fields'])*dim+(dim if self.kind!='static' else 0)
        for hidden in config['hidden']:
            layers.extend([nn.Linear(width,hidden),nn.ReLU()]);width=hidden
        layers.append(nn.Linear(width,1))

        fields=[embedding(batch['static'][:,i]) for i,embedding in enumerate(self.embeddings)]

def vecadd(*vs): return [sum(x) for x in zip(*vs)] if vs else [0.0]*3

def norm(v): return math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in v))
def close(a,b,tol=2e-10):

  for i in ids:w[i]=math.exp(scores[i]-m)/z/len(occupied)

 return scale(norm(ref)/max(z,1e-6),x) if z>1e-6 else [0.0]*3
def group_oracle(groups,wc,wb,c,b,h):

 for g in sorted(set(groups)-{-1}):
  ids=[i for i,x in enumerate(groups) if x==g]
  cm=[sum(c[i][j] for i in ids)/len(ids) for j in range(3)]
  bm=[sum(b[i][j] for i in ids)/len(ids) for j in range(3)]
  hm=[sum(h[i][j] for i in ids)/len(ids) for j in range(3)]
  for i in ids:
   for j in range(3):out[j]+=wc[i]*(c[i][j]-cm[j])+wb[i]*(b[i][j]-bm[j])+.5*(wc[i]+wb[i])*(h[i][j]-hm[j])

 for groups in itertools.product(range(-1,4),repeat=length):
  c=[[math.sin(i+1),float(i*i-2),1/(i+1)] for i in range(length)]
  b=[[float(2-i),math.cos(i),float(i%2)] for i in range(length)]
  h=[[float(i%3),.2*(i-2),math.sin(2*i)] for i in range(length)]
